sents.zh: 很久很久以前，中国下了很多天的雨。
sents.en: Very long ago, it rained in China for many days.

sents.zh: 因为雨太多，所以水越来越大。
sents.en: Because there was so much rain, the water rose higher and higher.

sents.zh: 水进了田里，也进了很多人的家。
sents.en: The water came into the fields, and into many people’s homes.

sents.zh: 大家没有地方住，只能住到山上去。
sents.en: People had nowhere to live, and could only move up the mountains.

sents.zh: 那时候的王很不放心，问大家应该怎么办。
sents.en: The king of that time was uneasy, and asked everyone what should be done.

sents.zh: 有人说：“大禹是个好人，让他来吧。”
sents.en: Someone said: "Dayu is a good man — let him come."

sents.zh: 大禹来了以后，先去看水，然后才开始工作。
sents.en: After Dayu came, he first went to look at the water, and only then began work.

sents.zh: 他发现，如果只用土把水关起来，水还会回来。
sents.en: He found that if you only shut the water in with earth, it would come back.

sents.zh: 所以他决定给水开一条路，让水流到海里去。
sents.en: So he decided to open a road for the water, letting it flow out to the sea.

sents.zh: 他和很多人一起做这件事，一做就是十三年。
sents.en: He did this together with many others, and it went on for thirteen years.

sents.zh: 虽然他很想家，但是他一直没有回去。
sents.en: Although he missed home, he never went back.

sents.zh: 有三次他走到自己家门口，都没有进去。
sents.en: Three times he came to his own door, and did not go in.

sents.zh: 后来水小了，大家又回到田里种东西。
sents.en: Later the water went down, and everyone returned to plant in the fields.

sents.zh: 因为他做了这件事，所以王把位子给了他。
sents.en: Because he had done this, the king gave his place to him.

sents.zh: 一直到今天，中国人还在说大禹的故事。
sents.en: To this day, Chinese people still tell the story of Dayu.
